harness_spec_view.purpose: Defines the fixed semantic testing plan. Global constraints occur once at the view root; branch-local elements occur only inside their source branch.

resolved_api_primitive_view.purpose: Defines the only permitted target API invocation primitive. A branch uses it once normally or twice with identical bindings for a selected determinism Oracle.

template_interface_view.purpose: Defines valid template placement and values supplied by the Harness template.

primitive_candidate_views.purpose: Defines the only non-target implementation primitives that may be selected. The target API primitive is supplied only through resolved_api_primitive_view.

input_unit.dynamic_identifier_rule: All source branch IDs, specification-element IDs, primitive IDs, slots, ports, parameters, and built-in value IDs must be copied exactly from the supplied input views.

dynamic_values.primitive_id: Must be an exact primitive_candidate_views.primitive_id or the exact resolved_api_primitive_view.target_api_primitive_id. The latter is permitted only for the unique target_call Step.
dynamic_values.template_slot: Must be an exact template_interface_view.available_slots value and valid for the selected primitive.
dynamic_values.port_id: Must be an exact declared input or output port ID of the selected primitive.
dynamic_values.parameter_id: Must be an exact declared parameter ID of the selected primitive.
dynamic_values.built_in_value_id: Must be an exact template_interface_view.built_in_values ID.

input_binding.port_id: An exact input port ID declared by the selected primitive.
input_binding.value_ref: Either an exact built-in value ID or an output_binding.value_id produced by an earlier step in the same branch.

output_binding.port_id: An exact output port ID declared by the selected primitive.
output_binding.value_id: A non-empty branch-local value identifier. The Builder may normalize it and rewrite local references deterministically.

parameter_binding.literal: binding_value is a JSON literal compatible with the selected parameter contract. JSON null is allowed only when that contract explicitly permits null.
parameter_binding.value_ref: binding_value is a value reference following the input_binding.value_ref convention.
parameter_binding.spec_parameter: binding_value is a spec_parameter_ref object that exactly matches an entry in harness_spec_view.exposable_spec_parameters and whose declared value_kind is compatible with the selected parameter contract. Runtime entity references such as subject_ref are not exposable parameters.

spec_binding.scope_rule: A non-global source element may be bound only in its own source branch. A global_constraint may be bound in every source branch.
spec_binding.coverage_rule: Each element listed in harness_spec_view.required_spec_elements must have exactly one spec_binding in its applicable branch.

conditional_requirements.materialized: implementation_plan is required and blocking_gaps is forbidden.
conditional_requirements.blocked: blocking_gaps must be non-empty and implementation_plan is forbidden.

materialized_plan_constraints.target_api_invocation_cardinality: Exactly one target API Step per branch, except that a branch implementing a determinism Oracle must contain exactly two target API Steps with identical input and parameter bindings.

satisfied_when_any: At least one output is consumed by a later step in the same branch.
The step is referenced by spec_binding.implementation_step_ids.
The step is one of the target API invocation steps permitted by target_api_invocation_cardinality.

blocked_response_constraints.spec_element_reference_rule: Set both fields to an exact required source element when one exact element is affected; otherwise set both fields to JSON null.
blocked_response_constraints.gap_grouping_rule: One gap may cover multiple branches only when root cause, reason code, missing capability or conflict, and affected semantic scope are the same.

actions: Validate raw local references, then normalize step and value identifiers using branch execution order and Catalog output-port order.
Reject unknown or duplicate implementation_step_ids and order valid IDs by branch step execution order.
Resolve the selected API-binding primitive against the API Profile.
Derive deterministic failure handlers from selected primitive outcome contracts.
Recompute exact API and Helper Profile content hashes before accepting their references.
Populate final record metadata, references, hashes, provenance, and review defaults.
Run final structural, reference, type-flow, slot-order, aggregate semantic-coverage, and dataflow-dependency validation.
Validate affected branch and optional specification-element references.
Record the synthesis diagnostic without creating a Strategy Plan record.
